stem:
The values in the table represent a linear relationship between x and y.

| x   | -8.5 | -6.5 | -2.5 | -1   |
|-----|------|------|------|------|
| y   | -92  | -72  | -32  | -17  |

What is the rate of change of y with respect to x?
